{{family name hatnote|Rebés|Ruiz|lang=Catalan}}
'''Marc Rebés Ruiz''' (born 3 July 1994) is an Andorran professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[centre-back]] and [[midfielder]] for [[Primera Divisió]] club [[FC Rànger's]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref name="NFT profile">{{cite web|title=NFT profile|url=http://www.national-football-teams.com/player/59489/Marc_Rebes.html|publisher=National Football Teams|accessdate=10 June 2017}}</ref>

==International career==
Rebés made his international debut on 6 June 2015 in a [[exhibition match|friendly]] against [[Equatorial Guinea national football team|Equatorial Guinea]].<ref name="NFT profile"/> On 9 June 2017 Rebés scored his first international goal in a 1–0 victory over [[Hungary national football team|Hungary]] in [[2018 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)|2018 FIFA World Cup qualifying]]. The game-winning goal provided Andorra with its first competitive victory in 66 matches spanning nearly 13 years, and its second competitive victory overall.<ref name="Andorra stun Hungary">{{cite web|title=Andorra stun Hungary to end 66-match winless run despite completing just 44 passes|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/football/2017/06/10/andorra-stun-hungary-end66-match-winless-run-despite-completing/|date=10 June 2017|publisher=The Telegraph|accessdate=10 June 2017}}</ref>
